@book{Grothendieck1955Memoir,
 author={Grothendieck, Alexander}, title={Produits tensoriels topologiques et espaces nucl\'eaires}, series={Memoirs of the American Mathematical Society}, number={16}, year={1955}, publisher={American Mathematical Society}, url={https://webusers.imj-prg.fr/~leila.schneps/grothendieckcircle/PTT.pdf}, note={Inspected fourth printing, 1966, copyright1955; entire382-page scan OCRed by root, relevant ChapterII section 1 pp13--22 read through. Hilbert genus-zero assertion p13 and actual unordered lp spectral continuity in Remark4 p21 are inputs to reductions, not proved there. Remark4 original pp20--22 visually checked independently by category, root and geometry; its dependency chain and ChapterI appendix pp194--195 checked. Title and copyright pages visually/OCR checked; original1955 printing not collated}}
